mapper.select: SELECT p.paragraph_id, p.order_number, pu_latest.content FROM paragraphs p INNER JOIN ( SELECT pu.paragraph_id, pu.content, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pu.paragraph_id ORDER BY ep.posted_at DESC ) AS rn FROM paragraph_updates pu INNER JOIN episode_posts ep ON pu.post_id = ep.post_id ) pu_latest ON p.paragraph_id = pu_latest.paragraph_id AND pu_latest.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN paragraph_deletes pd ON pd.paragraph_id = p.paragraph_id WHERE p.episode_id = #{episodeId} AND pd.paragraph_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.order_number ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO paragraph_updates (paragraph_id, episode_id, post_id, content) VALUES
(#{item.paragraphId}, #{item.episodeId}, #{item.postId}, #{item.content})

INSERT INTO paragraph_deletes (paragraph_id, episode_id, post_id) VALUES
(#{item.paragraphId}, #{item.episodeId}, #{item.postId})
